avis.texte: I like that melts the makeup very quick but is so oily and very hard to remove grom your skin after washing with water, you have to use a soap a couple times.

avis.titre: Glad I tried it but not for me
avis.texte: After finishing a full bottle, I give it 3/5 stars. I've been using farmacy's green clean remover (which is my absolute favorite) but I wanted to try something a little cheaper. Although naturium's balm had a nice texture and removed most makeup, it left a slight film and can burn your eyes. It did change into a milky consistency when mixed with water, but never fully washed off your face. I also noticed my facewash (which has stayed the same) doesn't foam like it normally does when I started using this balm. Not a major concern but noticed I needed a little more facewash than normal. Overall, not the best but not the worst!

I have been using this balm for a little over a month and it does okay with removing makeup but I strongly dislike the greasy film it leaves behind after rinsing. Makes me feel that I need to do multiple additional cleanses to both remove the residue from the balm then actually further clean my skin. I have dry skin so not a matter of other oiliness. Personally would not purchase again.

avis.titre: I wouldn't buy this product again
avis.texte: It leaves a weird residue as you emulsify (looks like little clumps). I've tried many different cleansing balms and this has never happened before. It also didn't make my face feel clean afterwards

I bought this after hearing fantastic reviews, particularly about it not agitating the eyes when removing eye make-up. Yes, this balm removed my make-up but 1) it sure did agitate the eyes (which I have closed tight; downward swipes of the product) and 2) it leaves a visible white-ish film on the face and fingers that does not come off when rinsing with water, other with another cleanser. At first, I thought it was just something that would go away as I continued to use the product, but it continued for nearly the entire tub. I thought I was using the product incorrectly, so I watched several videos from the founder and influencers and I couldn't see the leftover film and that I was using the product correctly. I've since used a different cleansing balm and it doesn't agitate the eyes or leave a film. I don't think I'll ever re-purchase this product; it's a miss for me.
This product is the closest I've come to duplicating the Clinique Take Off the Day cleansing balm. 10/10.

I love Naturium products but was pretty disappointed with this one. It's difficult to rinse off and it leaves behind a greasy residue, so I'm not sure how much it's actually cleansing my face. Will not be purchasing again.
It does the opposite of cleansing. It leaves a thick, greasy residue on your skin that doesn't come off easily. Wish I had tried it within 30 days of buying so I could return it.

My eyes have been itchy and irritated for a few weeks now and I am just realizing it's from this balm. This does a poor job taking off my makeup, it doesn't emulsify at all, I have to scrub and scrub and I still have mascara on my lashes. Def leaves your skin oily as well. Also sad to see frangrance on the ingredients. I really like the serum and moisturizer but this is a no from me. Very disappointed in this product
I absolutely loved this product, I have been using it for over two years. It's gentle and does the job. I stock up on it.

I used it to take my eye makeup off and it made my eyes burn. It left a weird thick oily residue after I washed it off with water and cleanser so I had to use soap to fully get it off my face. I'm never using this thing again I hate it😭
Very light yet effectively removes any traces of makeup. I like to rub it in and then use a makeup removing wipe to get everything out. It's a great product!
Used to be my holy grail. But since this year formula change... I hate it it. The only way to get the residue off is with bar soap. The new formula has cause clogged pores and breakouts.

I used to love this product for double cleansing. I would start with the cleansing balm and finish with a gentle gel cleanser and my skin loved it! tested and tried so many cleansing oils and balm and this was my absolute favorite. HOWEVER.... I HATE the formula change that occurred this year. I was my face TWICE with gel cleanser after using the new cleansing balm and it it still leaves residue. My pores have become clogged and I'm starting to break out. I'm so disappointed and annoyed to have to go back on the hunt for a new product.

Wanted to love it but I can't. I love the fermented camelia cleansing oil so thought I'd give this a try, but this one is too sticky and takes a lot longer to wash off. I end up using my cleaner twice after using the cleansing balm because I feel like it's not all the way off my skin.

First this leaves a film on the skin that does not rinse away. After a second wash with a cleanser my skin still feels like its not completely gone. After about a week of use i now have clogged pores and blackheads on my chin and nose. Its a shame because ive loved everything else by this brand but this is a big miss. Ill stick with Farmacy

Being that I have oily skin I was skeptical about using an oil based cleanser/balm. However following the instructions of their routine builder I got it and I'm glad I did! It makes a major difference when using at night as the first step in double cleansing. My skin appreciates every time I use this first and then follow up with the gelee.

avis.titre: My sister and I Love it
avis.texte: I tried it out when it first came out and it does the job of removinf hard make up, suncreen, eyeliner, mascara. It works better with a double cleanse but overall for the price and how much you are getting its a really good cleansing balm compared to others with the same price range and amount. My sister tried it out when it got to ulta and it still works the same. If you dont wanna splirge but need something to help remove your waterresistant stuff this will work!

Works great to take make up off and leaves skin hydrated. My eyes are super sensitive to products and gets irritated very easily, but this cleanser doesn't irritate my eyes at all. Will definitely repurchase!
I tried it but really didn't like it. It made my skin feel super oily and then that weird feeling of after playing with playdoh.

avis.titre: Fragrance free even with the name being 'ginseng'
avis.texte: My sports laroche-posay spf 50 is the only white cast sunscreen I use. I can't wash it off with my regular body wash. even my prequel gleanser isn't enough. this is my first balm cleanser. I like it because it does melt everything off. Fragrance free is a plus! I like how smooth it is, I don't have to tug my skin in contrast with my haruharu oil cleanser it can run once it's on my hands. You don't waste any product with this balm. I repurchased it without trying it first and that was the right decision. Queston: Where's the expiration date?

avis.titre: Works amazing if you follow instructions
avis.texte: I love this cleansing balm! It melts makeup off well... As far as the other reviews saying it leaves a film, the instructions clearly say follow up with a second cleanse. It's a necessity in my skin care routine to wash off makeup.
Even though the price is affordable, it's not worth breaking out for. If you wanna go afforable, it's better just to get the elf balm at least that won't break you out
The best!!!! I needed something to remove makeup gently without drying my skin. This is perfection. Leave my skin so soft! Removes makeup effectively too!

avis.titre: Gave my an itchy flakey rash :(
avis.texte: Seems nice but gave me a rash, currently pregnant and this was recommended by a derm PA, my skin has been a little dry but since I started using this I have gotten a flakey itchy dry skin rash in one patch of my cheek.

avis.titre: Truly Awful But Not a Total Waste
avis.texte: I hated this as a face cleanser. It doesn't remove makeup or sunscreen very well. Or even rinse off without a ton of scrubbing. It's literally the worst face cleanser I've ever purchased. However, I gave it an extra star because it actually kinda works as a hand cleanser in the winter when your hands are super chapped and you're going to put lotion on immediately. So it wasn't a total waste of money.

This cleansing balm will get off your base makeup and sunscreen okay, will definitely make your eyes a bit blurry but does get off the makeup. My biggest gripe is that after I rinse this off I still feel a layer of balminess on my skin. I have to use a more intense second cleanse to get it off instead of my usual gentle cream cleanser.
A lovely first step in my skincare routine. I use this first to take off makeup, then wash with the gel cleanser.

avis.titre: Gets out makeup and doesn't leave you dry
avis.texte: Gets out most of my stubborn mascara. I don't like the smell. It leaves my skin moisturized.
Melts nicely & easy to massage...BUT just horrible for eye area. Even with 2nd cleanser hard to wash residue off around eyes. Defaulting to my Peach & Lily cleanser.

avis.titre: My go to in my double cleanse routine!
avis.texte: I have repurchased this makeup remover several times now. It melts into the skin pretty easily, and I can wipe the residue off with a cotton round. It works great and I haven't had any issues with it! Works well with the rest of my products as well. I suggest follwing up with a foaming cleanser.

avis.titre: My go to in my double cleanse routine!
avis.texte: I have repurchased this makeup remover several times now. It melts into the skin pretty easily, and I can wipe the residue off with a cotton round. It works great and I haven't had any issues with it! Works well with the rest of my products as well. I suggest follwing up with a foaming cleanser.
I was excited to try this cleansing balm but it did not do a great job. I wear a good amount of makeup like a full face. Twice I had to cleanse to remove and still found eyeliner residue after.

avis.titre: Burned eyes and caused an allergic reaction
avis.texte: I stupidly purchased this product based on all the hype through their promotions and instagram posts. I've utilized the Farmacy balm in the past and loved it but as it was sold out near me, I went ahead and purchased this one. It caused my eyes to burn so I immediately rinsed it off and then used a cleanser and moisturized but by then the damage was done. It's been a week and the skin around my eyes feels like it's on fire and as if there are tiny cuts all over. I'm working on repairing the skin barrier and ended up returning the product. I'm unsure of what the exact irritant in the product is but I would encourage anyone who is looking to purchase it to do research and perhaps speak to a dermatologist before using it. I don't have highly sensitive skin and have experimented with products in the past. This is the only new product is introduced into my routine and have never had such an experience before. I'm hoping that my skin heals and I don't end up with scars or long term dry skin issues.
It doesnt really remove my makeup all the way and I really wanted to try it because it has ginseng in it but not purchasing again
I dont love this cleansing balm. It made me break out and felt heavy on my skin. Also burned my eyes and left a weird film. Did take off makeup though.
This has no scent and works well taking off my full face of makeup and even waterproof mascara with no raccoon residue

My skin is normally very forgiving of new products and I am not acne prone at all, but two days into introducing these cleansing balm and the entire lower portion of my face is broken out. My partner is having the same reaction. After a little more research it seems as though this is a pretty common response. There are better balms out there.

I have sensitive combination skin. That being said, I have never broken out with any type of balm remover. It mustve been clogging my pores. Aside from that, thr balm didnt emulsify thst well and left a film on my skin. I always double cleanse when using these types of products, but I never felt such a thick film after a balm, mixed w balm and my makeup partially removed. A real mess! Other balms are a little more expensive but seem worth it compared to this
It melts my makup so nicely, it is hydrating but does leave my face feeling a little heavy, always use a cleanser after a melting balm

avis.titre: broke me out, a lot of under the skin pimples
avis.texte: i was so excited to try this but it broke me out so bad for weeks on end. im not allergic to any of the ingredients, not acne prone, and have normal skin, so i dont know why it happened, but i will never purchase again.
I bought it on Black Friday sale and I am so disappointed that it doesn't do what it supposed to do. It does not melt my make up specially my mascara.

This removes all makeup easily. I don't use waterproof makeup so i cant speak go that, but regular makeup is no problem. The only downside is that it may sting your eyes. It doesn't every time but it does sometimes. That's why i only give 4 stars.

avis.titre: Will definitely be buying this product from now on
avis.texte: Best product I've ever used to remove makeup! Makes my skin feel super soft.

This product worked well to remove makeup, but after about a month of use I noticed my skin getting super congested in areas. I feel really silly for not doing my research on the contents prior to purchase, but this product contains multiple comedogenic ingredients.
Leaves a greasy film on your face. I want to cleanse the oil and dirt away, not add to it. I wouldn't repurchase.

avis.titre: Naturium is now my holy grail!!
avis.texte: I am 42 with sensitive skin and hormonal acne. I have tried a lot of products and until now have only been able to use Charlotte Tilbury (didnt like the fragrance) and DIME Beauty. I consider skincare as an investment & will always spend whatever is needed to take care of my largest organ (which is also my 1st layer of defense). My mother has been drilling skincare and protection into me since my teens and I am so grateful that she did!! I constantly am told that I look 10-15yrs younger than I am, but I have never had the amount of complements about my skin as I've had since I started using all Naturium facial products (about 2 months ago). I wanted to share my skincare routine since I haven't found many reviews that have it spelled out (*please note: what works for me may/may not work for you): Morning: • Wash: Niacinaminde Cleansing Gelée • Tone: Niacinamide Essence • Serums: ~Vitamin C Complex Serum ~Niacinamide Serum 12% + Zinc 2% • Eye Cream: Plant Ceramide Rich Cream • Sunscreen: Dew-Glow SPF50++++ (original or tinted) ☆Once or twice a week exfoliate after wash: ~Skin Script Raspbery Scrub ~BHA Liquid ☆Once or twice a week use an ice roller ☆Once a month dermaplane/shave face Evening: • Remove Makeup: ~Naturium Cleansing Balm ~Micellar Water • Wash: Niacinaminde Cleansing Gelée • Tone: Niacinamide Essence • Eye Cream: Plant Ceramide Rich Cream ~Night #1 - Retinaldahyde 0.05% ~Night #2 - Vit C Super Serum Plus ~Night #3 - AHA Exfoliating Mask 10% ~Night #4 - Vit C Super

avis.titre: Yes, yes, yes. Lovely cleansing balm.
avis.texte: Lighter in weight than the Elemis (which I had to stop using since it caused my sink to be clogged), and less fragrant than the elf cosmetics balm, this removes my makeup and sunscreen really well and will remain part of my two-step cleanse process. I appreciate the Naturium brand very much. This product really delivers a lovely experience. I enjoy how it emulsifies so nicely when I add water. It rinses clean without residue, and when I follow up with micellar water, the cotton ball comes away clean!
Pretty packaging, I felt like I had to use a lot to get it to work. It did NOT feel easy to melt off my makeup or rinse off easily.
I'm a new customer to this product and I love it. It does melt your makeup away without scrubbing, leaving your skin feeling smooth and silky. I don't know how I managed this long without it.

This is my favorite cleansing balm I've ever tried. The texture is amazing, gets all my waterproof makeup off without leaving a residue. I have sensitive, dry skin and this doesnt leave me feeling dry or irritate my skin. Also love that its fragrance free! I need them to come out with a mini for travel!
The #1 reason I use a balm over an oil is that it removes eye makeup so much easier, but this one really burns my eyes. There are so many others that are much more gentle and enjoyable.
this made me breakout so bad and always had my eyes burning really bad!! the ingredients r bad

Ive tried numerous other cleansing balm that do not even come close to how good the Naturium one is!! Previous balms have left a film in my eyes or do not remove my waterproof mascara, but this one does and does not leave my eyes cloudy!! Will repurchase over and over again!

This cleansing balm is my favorite. It takes off all my makeup including anything waterproof. None of my mascara gets left behind. From other reviews saying it leaves a film I dont think are using it right. Plus, its supposed to be a first cleanse and then you follow up with your second cleanse which would get rid of anyhting left over.

avis.titre: I couldnt give it a second shot
avis.texte: It made my eyes burn!! And it left a super waxy residue on my face. Thought that maybe I just didnt wash it off all the way, so I washed with water again…still waxy. I thought maybe I should give it a few more tries before returning, but after a few seconds of thought I realized i'd rather return it.

avis.titre: Burns my eyes and leaves a film!
avis.texte: This cleansing balm burns my eyes so bad! I can't even open them when removing my mascara, and I've used this mascara with other cleansing balms without issue. It also leaves a film on the face after rinsing off.

After using this for about a week, I will say this gets the job done. It had no problem with waterproof or long-wearing makeup. It didn't leave my skin feeling tight or filmy, but it's not exactly hydrating. Which is fine because I use plenty of other hydrating products and don't need it at every step of my routine. No eye blurriness, and trust me I really scrub my eyes. The only con really is that it doesn't smell great. I was expecting something more herbal, but it smells like plain wax or clean plastic. Not obnoxiously though. It's not enough for me to stop using or return it. It's more like you can tell this isn't fragranced because you can smell the waxes used. Price point is great too. Definitely something I'll keep as an option when looking for a cleansing balm.
Its very smooth and i like that there isnt really a scent. Highly recommend!!!

I love using a cleansing balm as my first step at night, but I always have the issue of going temporarily blind after using them for my eye makeup. I did NOT have that problem with this one! My skin feels so smooth and clean after I use thjs balm. Only con is the packaging is quite large- I've been using consistently for 3 weeks and I am about to run out, however I will be repurchasing despjte that!

I bought this after getting into Korean oil cleansers because I wanted to try a non-Korean brand, and I love that this has ginseng! It has a light scent and does a great job at removing makeup, but I stopped using it because it leaves an oily residue on my skin after I wash it off. It's not a huge deal because I double cleanse and my foam cleanser removes the residue, so this product is fine if having that residue briefly between cleanses doesn't bother you. But I have other cleaners that don't do that so I no longer use this product. Will keep though in case I run out of other oil cleaners and need a backup.

avis.titre: I always come back to this cleansing balm
avis.texte: I'm surprised by some of the negative reciews! I will say, for people saying it stings, it might be the combo with your mascara brand. I think ive tried every brand out there and this is one of my faves, especially for the price!

This is my favorite cleansing balm! It gets off all my makeup easily, including waterproof mascara. Never burns my eyes, and doesn't leave my contacts with a film on them. I also think it's a very good price for the amount of product you get, you don't need to use a lot to get a good cleanse. I wipe it off with a makeup eraser before using a traditional cleanser for a double cleanse. Leaves skin clean without feeling stripped.

I love this as my first cleanser to clean off make up and sunscreen. Feels great on the skin and gets rid of everything. Only down side is it can sting your eyes if it gets in there which can happen when removing eye makeup.

avis.titre: My least favorite cleansing balm so far
avis.texte: I have been on a journey to try all the cleansing balms at Ulta. I've heard good things about this brand and wanted to try. This has been my least favorite in all that i have tried. It doesnt emulsify well and leaves a residue on the skin. It also lightly stings the eyes when used to remove makeup. I would not use this again

I REALLY wanted to like this cleansing balm. I have been on the hunt for an inexpensive, cruelty free cleasing balm for awhile. Unfortunately, it disappointed. It does take of makeuo pretty well; however, it not only left an oil residue, but it really stings when it gets in the eyes.

I was out of my other EL… balm and saw this was recommended on youtube. It was for dry skin that is prone to breakouts as it also had anti-fungal properties for acne. This is very emollient and easy to apply and remove makeup as a first cleanse. My skin Has looked great and I do use a wash cloth or paper towel as I feel slight film after using. Ibhave sensitive dry skin with some congestion in zone and so far I love this. This is gentle and not harsh, no strong smell. With a coupon this is a great buy for amount of product.

avis.titre: This product made me a cleansing balm girly!!
avis.texte: SO excited Ulta is carrying naturium. This balm gently removes makeup and feels so luxurious!

Works really well and doesn't have a scent. Feels good going on, but I do find it doesn't rinse off as easily as I would like. Even with repeated emulsification, it feels heavy and thick. After applying my second cleanser, it does all come off though.

I recently purchased. Upon first use it burned my eyes amd blurred my vision after. I used sparingly to remove eye makeup. I have used Albolene for a long time and wanted to try something different just to see. I will be staying with Albolene because it does not burn or irritate my eyes.

avis.titre: Absolutely love this product. Whisks off makeup!
avis.texte: Love love love it but can you please make it in a jumbo size? I go through it fairly quickly and a larger size would me less packaging to deal with!

When I ran out of my usual cleansing balm, I decided to try this one because I'm a fan of other naturium products. This left a filmy layer on my skin (even after using a second cleanser), had a strong processed smell, and broke my skin out! I'm not prone to breakouts, but had a ton after my first week of use. It might be great for someone without oily or combination skin, but I think there are more effective and cheaper options out there.

This product is MY holy grail, but might not be for everyone. My skin always looks better when I consistently use this as a first cleanse and then I follow up with LaRoche Posay gentle hydrating cleanser. It does leave an oily feel to your skin so I recommend this for people who have dry skin. I took accutane in the past so I no longer struggle with breakouts, however I could see this causing breakouts for people who are sensitive to oils.

So, let me start off by saying I use MULTIPLE Naturium products daily. I tried this ginseng cleansing balm when it first came out because a balm is my first step for removing the day. This product sadly didn't approve my expectations:( When you put it on around your eyes, it will burn! Now I use balm on and around my eyes daily. This product is the only balm that has ever burned my eyes :( I thought "maybe" I got it in SIDE my eyes and that's what done it..? No. I ended up using the entire bottle, cause it IS very good. But I kept it away from my eyes for the rest of the bottle. And used a different balm for my eyes. My favorite balm out of all balms I've tried is the Elf! It's the only one I've used that doesn't bother around my eyes. I love ginseng in products, just not for around the eyes.

Love this balm. Don't have to use too much at one time and melts the makeup right off of my face. Doesn't leave my skin feeling super oily/sticky after I wash it unlike some other cleansing balms I've tried.
Love this balm. It leaves my face feeling so smooth! It rinses all the day off easily! #dailymakeupwearer
Never received, would have loved to try but customer service never responded to any of my 3 emails regarding the missing package with my order. Very dissapointed
I love this cleansing balm and buy it 3 at a time so I never run out! Really soft and creamy with a light almost grape scent that is nice. Best balm I've tried!
Good at removing make up, sometimes its hard to emulsify but iI like it
This leaves my skin feeling so soft! Great at removing makeup and sunscreen. I use it first and follow up with Niacinamide Cleansing Gelée 3% for a double cleanse moment.
Best cleansing balm I've ever used. I've tried them all from drugstore to luxury & this works the best for me. Will repurchase.

Works good and the jar is nice just too big for the product you get. Takes up a lot of space on the shelf. Not feasible when you have a large skincare collection so I probably wouldn't reach for it again. But it's works well.

I like the texture of this cleansing balm - it melted nicely on my skin and did a thorough job of taking off makeup. It did seem to require more rinsing than other first step cleansers I've used. My main gripe is that it broke me out horribly. I checked the ingredient listing and Ethylhexyl Palmitate is the first ingredient, which is highly acnegenic. If you have acne prone or reactive skin, I'd suggest skipping this.
Takes make up off so easily and doesn't sting the eyes at all.
Great first step in double cleanse. Dissolves makeup and spf. Isn't harsh on skin. Doesn't leave the weird foggy eye phenomenon of some oil based cleansers.
Love this for my first cleanse. Leaves Skin feeling soft and removes makeup.

avis.titre: Purple ginseng cleansing balm honest review! LOVE!
avis.texte: Super clean! Love it. Helps to get all of my makeup off in once cleanse.

avis.titre: The perfect first step in a 2-step routine!
avis.texte: One of my favorite cleansing balms on the market! Affordable and takes any makeup and sunscreen right off.
The worst product! its exactly what others have said. its slimy and leaves a film on the skin. i regret every naturium purchase so far.

I use this as the first step in my double cleanse, but unfortunately, I don't find it rinses off well, so I end up having to triple cleanse to get this off. I was hoping this would be different as some rinse off and some don't, but this sadly, this doesn't.
Im surprised how well this balm works. Instantly melts off my eye make-up, and my foundation. I rinse very well with a cloth and follow with the rice cleanser...its thorough.

I will never use makeup wipes or the micellar water again! You don't need a lot, a little goes a long way. The consistency is nice, no smell and it wipes off all my makeup- even the waterproof mascara. My skin was left glowing after this

avis.titre: Works well but still a little makeup remaining
avis.texte: This removes all the makeup but will leave some residue and a little makeup so you need to follow up with a cleanser

avis.titre: Great balm! Melts the makeup away!
avis.texte: Love, love this balm! Was hesitant as I am acne prone but it has actually help my skin so much plus it melts the makeup in a heartbeat
It's alright. My skin doesn't feel totally clean when I'm done. It feels like a film is on my skin. I've used cheaper cleansing balms that do a better job.
Love the rich texture, melts in your skin and melts away even waterproof makeup. A must for double cleaning!

My current cleansing balm was not cutting it, so I decided to switch things up. Susan Yara was instrumental in my skincare journey, so I decided to try her brand. So far, totally in love. Its the most lovely creamy texture and glides on the face so comfortably. No fragrance, super smooth, and takes all of my makeup and sunscreen off. 10/10!

Are we not yet over the hugely plasticky cleansing balms of the past??? This has those gritty bits of polyethylene that just wouldn't break down, no matter what - and they then scratched at my skin. It also has a really strange smell - sort of sour. I'm all for not adding any fragrance or perfumes, but this was just nasty.
This formula is incredible, but I absolutely can't take the smell. It doesn't linger, but it is not pleasant as I wash my face. If this was unscented, I would repurchase.
This is the perfect cleansing balm! It melts away skincare/makeup effortlessly!
So far so good. I just feel it's a little pricey for the amount and what it is.

avis.titre: Best cleansing balm! and cannot beat the price.
avis.texte: This is my favorite cleansing balm and I have tried many out there on the market. As soon as you apply this to your face, it literally melts all the makeup and dirt of the day off. It leaves the skin nice and soft once washed away. I use this as my first cleanse in the evening. I alternate this between the Naturium Camellia Gel/Oil which I also like but the balm just melts everything off very quickly. For the size and price, you can't beat it. One of the best out there. A supersize jar would be awesome! Love this cleansing balm.

Been trying this out and it does work well. It doesn't break me out or cause irritation. It's fragrance free but imo it has a plastic scent to it that's a little off putting to me personally but it doesn't affect the performance. You get a good amount and it has good ingredients. You do need to cleanse after using this. I like the elf one a little better for the price.

This has a very nice consistency and rinses off very well. You don't need to use much so this jar should last at least 6 months or longer. I use it for my double cleanse days and really love that it's fragrance-free so that it doesn't compete with my other products.
This is my favorite cleansing balm! Super smooth and breaks down everything so well, I just wish it came in a jumbo size!

avis.titre: Melts easily, makeup doesn't come off immediately
avis.texte: You do have to work a bit to get your makeup to come off, but the texture and they way the balm melts onto your skin is actually amazing and feels so good!

Again, I love trying out new things and know it takes some time to adjust to it, to practice, and to be patient with results. However, this was waxy like, and like the pink camelia oil jelly one - this left a greasy residue. It was insane that the oil cleansers didn't do anything but make cleansing harder. I only care for the retinal products at this point.
Forever repurchase!!! I have one at my vanity, one in bath, one in shower!
Scoop a little out and warm up in your hands! Then apply to your face and add some water to emulsify. I only double cleanse at night but i have noticed a significant difference in my skin!
A nice balm to remove makeup. Nice smell. I think it's good for any skin concern.
I was a little skeptical at first but this removes even mascara with no issue & I don't have film left in my eyes after using like I did with other cleansing balms. Will definitely be repurchasing.
Always 100% I've found nothing that treats and improves my skin like this! Natrium, Purple Ginseng is great for me.
So silky smooth! Love it for double cleanse. Melts easy, turns milky with water.

avis.titre: My absolute favorite!!! Better than all the rest
avis.texte: The texture is silky, it emulsifies nicely. Removes ALL make-up and spf.

I'm a bit Confused by this product. It's the strangest balm I've used To date. It doesn't emulsify and leaves a greasy residue on your face. You will have to do a double cleanse and maybe a third cleanse. I wasn't even wearing makeup just sunscreen.

avis.titre: Best make up remover for dry skin
avis.texte: This cleansing balm is gentle, thorough, and nurturing to my very dry complexion. I massage it in, and follow with a warm, wet washcloth. My skin actually glows after cleansing with this balm!

avis.titre: The only Naturium prod that hasn't worked for me
avis.texte: I really wanted to love this product. It helped remove my makeup and had such a good consistency, unfortunately it made my rosacea and sensitive skin turn more red. I ended up giving it to a friend who loves this. It didn't work for me but not everything is meant to be for everyone.
